patterns.root_cause: VPC ID invalid or VPC deleted
patterns.prevention: Cache VPC ID from listVpcs before operations

patterns.root_cause: Subnet CIDR overlaps existing subnet in same VPC

fix.action: List existing subnets: hcloud VPC listSubnets --vpc_id {{output.vpc_id}}; pick a non-overlapping /24

patterns.prevention: Pre-allocate non-overlapping CIDR plan; validate before create

patterns.root_cause: Security group ID invalid or already deleted
patterns.prevention: Cache SG ID at provisioning time

fix.action: Delegate to huaweicloud-iam-ops for quota raise

patterns.prevention: Check quota via showQuota before bulk operations

fix.action: List existing rules: hcloud VPC showSecurityGroup --id {{output.sg_id}}; dedupe

patterns.prevention: Diff existing rules before add; idempotent apply

patterns.root_cause: API rate limit on VPC control plane

fix.action: Exponential backoff with jitter; respect Retry-After

patterns.root_cause: EIP already bound to another resource

fix.action: Unbind first: hcloud VPC disassociateEip --eip_id {{output.eip_id}}; or pick another EIP

patterns.prevention: Track EIP-resource binding via CTS before reuse

patterns.root_cause: VPC peering ID invalid or rejected by remote VPC

fix.action: Verify acceptance: hcloud VPC listVpcPeerings --status PENDING_ACCEPTANCE; ensure both VPCs in same project

patterns.prevention: Validate peering config + acceptance state before traffic

patterns.root_cause: Default route table + custom route table both applied to same subnet

fix.action: Disassociate custom route table: hcloud VPC disassociateRouteTable --subnet_id {{output.subnet_id}}

patterns.prevention: Use custom route tables only; document subnet associations

patterns.root_cause: EIP bandwidth cap reached; throttle or upgrade

fix.action: Modify EIP bandwidth: hcloud VPC updateEipBandwidth --eip_id {{output.eip_id}} --bandwidth {{output.bw_mbps}}
